item.title: Native Works Gazelle 270
item.excerpt:
This lures is designed to attract fish when the bite is slow in general.
Best action: allow the lure to swim on a slower retrieve in order to create a wider S shape to get the best action out of it.

Recommended hooks: BKK GT-Rex 7/0 or BKK Inline 11/0 on the Belly  9/0 on the tail.

  • Length 270 mm

  • Gr. 210

nextItem.title: Native Works Napalm 200
nextItem.excerpt:
The world famous Napalm diving popper from Native Works.
Handmade in Japan, very small production.

They are very easy to move, very easy to dive and do a big difference when a pencil can not be used.
Intense bubble trail and motion.
Swims in any sea conditions.

DONT MISS OUT of these amazing diving poppers! Proven catcher on many fishes all around the globe!

100% handmade in Japan by Mr Kawauchi Kenichi, his lures are exceptional and undoubtly unique.

  • Length 200 mm

  • Gr. 90
